name: FreshBooks
description_en:
FreshBooks is hosted invoicing and small-business accounting software that links client work, tracked time, expenses and payments. A service business can use it to turn billable work into an invoice and then inspect what was billed, paid and recorded.

Client allowances, accounting features, team seats and payment services vary by plan or add-on. This profile uses the US-facing pricing page and official workflow descriptions; it does not establish availability or the same prices in every country. No account, invoice or payment was tested.
description_zh:
FreshBooks 是托管的开票与小企业会计软件，将客户工作、工时、费用和付款连接起来。服务企业可以把可计费工作转为发票，再检查已开票、已收款和账务记录。

客户额度、会计功能、团队席位和支付服务取决于套餐或附加项。本文使用美国站定价及官方流程说明，不能证明所有国家都有相同价格或可用性；未实际创建账户、发票或支付。

core_features.explanation_en: Start a timer or record worked hours against clients/projects and pull billable time onto an invoice.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可为客户或项目启动计时器或补录工时，再把可计费工时放入发票。

core_features.explanation_en: Invoice tools describe recurring templates, payment reminders and optional late fees.
core_features.explanation_zh: 开票工具介绍周期模板、付款提醒及可选逾期费用。

core_features.explanation_en: Accounting tools let an accountant work with journals, the chart and reports; plan entitlement must be checked.
core_features.explanation_zh: 会计工具允许会计人员处理日记账、科目和报表，需核对套餐权限。

pricing.billing_basis: US-facing plan, billable-client allowance, chargeable team members and optional services; payment processing separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Regular monthly Lite $23, Plus $43, Premium $70; Select custom. 80% initial discount for four months is temporary; extras apply.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 常规月费 Lite $23、Plus $43、Premium $70；Select 定制报价。前四个月优惠 80% 为临时促销，另有附加费用。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Trace billable work before sending an invoice
sections.title_zh: 发送发票前追踪可计费工作
sections.en:
The time-tracking page describes starting a timer or adding past hours for a client and project, then using the time on an invoice. The invoice page adds client expenses, recurring billing and payment reminders. The practical benefit to evaluate is continuity between work and billing, not the number of labels in a feature table.

For a hypothetical consultant, four hours at an agreed $80 plus a $30 billable expense would produce $350 before tax or discounts. Check the selected client, rate, hours and expense before sending; this arithmetic is an illustrative input, not a FreshBooks quote or measured result. A recorded hour is not automatically proof the client agreed to pay for it.
sections.zh:
工时页面介绍为客户和项目启动计时器或补录已工作小时数，再把工时用于开票。发票页面还介绍客户费用、周期计费及付款提醒。应评估工作与计费之间能否连续衔接，而非功能表有多少标签。

以假设的顾问项目为例，按约定每小时 $80 工作四小时，再加 $30 可转付费用，税前折前合计为 $350。发送前检查客户、费率、工时和费用。这只是算例输入，不是 FreshBooks 报价或实测收益；记录了工时也不证明客户同意支付。

sections.title_en: A draft, a sent invoice and a paid invoice have different effects
sections.title_zh: 草稿、已发送和已付款发票作用不同
sections.en:
The invoice guide distinguishes saving a new draft from sending it. It also documents importing unbilled time/expenses, deposits, payment schedules and invoice-specific online-payment settings. Confirm the due date because reminders and late fees follow that date. Invoice numbers must be unique even for archived or deleted invoices.

The guide says drafts do not appear in reports; sent invoices do. An invoice’s delivery status therefore matters to accounting, not only presentation. In a disposable evaluation, check a draft, a sent invoice and a partial payment, and compare their report treatment. This profile did not execute those transitions or verify tax recognition for a particular business.
sections.zh:
发票指南区分新建后保存为草稿与发送发票，也说明如何导入未开票工时和费用、设置预付款、分期付款及单张发票的线上支付选项。应确认到期日，因为提醒和逾期费用基于该日期；即使发票已归档或删除，编号也必须保持唯一。

指南说明草稿不进入报表，而发送后的发票会进入，因此单据交付状态也影响账务，并不只是展示。在临时评估中可检查草稿、已发送及部分付款状态的报表处理；本文未执行这些变化，也未验证特定企业的税务确认。

sections.title_en: Client limits count more than invoices
sections.title_zh: 客户限制并非发票数量限制
sections.en:
The US pricing page read on 22 October 2026 lists regular monthly USD prices of $23 for Lite, $43 for Plus and $70 for Premium, with Select quoted separately. It displays an 80% discount for four months; those initial prices should not be used as the ongoing rate. Lite allows five billable clients, Plus fifty and Premium/Select unlimited.

The FAQ says active and archived clients count toward the allowance. It distinguishes deleting a client from archiving one and says historical invoice information remains accessible. Do not plan around unlimited invoices alone when the constraint is client count. Plus’s card explicitly includes accountant access and accounting reports; compare the retained plan after the trial rather than assuming trial access persists.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的美国定价页列出常规美元月费：Lite $23、Plus $43、Premium $70，Select 单独报价；同时展示前四个月优惠 80% 的促销，不能把首次促销价当持续费率。Lite 可计费客户为 5 个，Plus 为 50 个，Premium 和 Select 不限。

FAQ 说明活跃及归档客户都占用额度，删除与归档不同，并表示历史发票资料仍可访问。因此客户数受限时，不能只看不限发票。Plus 介绍明确列出会计访问及会计报表；应比较试用后保留的套餐，不推定所有试用权限都会延续。

sections.title_en: Seats and payment services change the total
sections.title_zh: 席位和支付服务会改变总费用
sections.en:
The same pricing page lists extra team members at USD $11 per user monthly, Advanced Payments at $20 monthly for the listed lower plans, and payroll at $40 monthly plus $6 per user. These are separate from the accounting subscription. Payment processing also has its own fees and eligibility; an online-payment button does not establish settlement timing or availability in every jurisdiction.

For a hypothetical Plus subscriber adding one chargeable team member, the displayed regular subscription components total $54 monthly before tax and other charges. Select includes two team-member accounts and Advanced Payments in its displayed offer, so do not apply the same add-on arithmetic to every plan. Obtain current checkout and processor terms for the actual country and payment method.
sections.zh:
同一定价页列出额外团队成员每人每月 $11，所列较低套餐的 Advanced Payments 每月 $20，薪资为每月 $40 再加每用户 $6；均与会计订阅分开。支付处理还有自己的手续费和资格条件，出现线上付款按钮不能证明所有地区的可用性或结算时间。

若假设 Plus 用户另加一个收费团队成员，按常规展示价格合计为税前及其他费用前每月 $54。Select 展示方案包含两个团队成员账户及 Advanced Payments，不能对所有套餐套用相同加价算式。实际购买需按国家和付款方式核对当前结账及支付条款。

sections.title_en: Accounting reports still depend on complete source records
sections.title_zh: 会计报表仍依赖完整源记录
sections.en:
The accounting page describes accountant access to journal entries and the chart of accounts, financial reports and bank-reconciliation workflows. The invoice guide also lets users bring unbilled time and expenses into customer billing. Those links can help a service business connect operational work with the books, provided the records and dates are correct.

Before switching, prepare opening balances, clients, services/rates and the bank statement used for reconciliation. Test a reimbursable expense, duplicate input and a credit or refund, then compare the resulting customer balance and financial reports. These are suggested acceptance checks. This research did not establish inventory/manufacturing depth, local tax filing or that buying the accounting plan includes every payroll function.
sections.zh:
会计页面介绍会计人员访问日记账和科目表、财务报表及银行对账流程；发票指南还允许把未开票工时和费用纳入客户账单。在记录和日期正确的前提下，这些联系可以帮助服务企业连接业务与账簿。

迁移前准备期初余额、客户、服务费率及用于对账的银行对账单。建议测试可报销费用、重复输入和贷项或退款，再对照客户余额与财务报表。以上属于验收建议。本次未确立库存制造深度、当地税务申报能力，也不能认为购买会计套餐就包含全部薪资功能。

sections.title_en: A trial is temporary and bank links have an expiry consequence
sections.title_zh: 试用有期限，银行连接也受影响
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ describes a 30-day trial without a credit card. Afterward users choose a paid plan; if they do not subscribe, the FAQ says data is stored for a later upgrade and any bank connection is severed until use resumes. That is a concrete reason to review trial expiry before depending on imported transactions.

FreshBooks is web-based with iOS/Android apps described separately. Hosted access removes a local server-installation step, but not the need to confirm export, retention, recovery and access roles. It is worth evaluating for a freelancer or service team connecting hours and expenses to billing; no ease-of-use, savings or reliability score was measured here.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 介绍无需信用卡的 30 天试用；之后需选择付费套餐。如未订阅，FAQ 表示数据会保存待以后升级，原有银行连接则中断，恢复使用后才继续。因此在依赖导入交易前，要明确试用到期影响。

FreshBooks 以网页方式提供，iOS 和 Android 应用另行介绍。托管访问省去了本地服务器安装步骤，但仍需确认导出、保留、恢复及访问角色。希望把工时和费用连接到计费的自由职业者或服务团队可以评估；本文未测易用性、节省或可靠性评分。

research_gaps.en: Regional checkout, processor eligibility/fees, export/retention, recovery and local tax coverage were not independently established or tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未独立确认或测试地区结账、支付资格费率、导出保留、恢复及当地税务覆盖。

research_gaps.en: No time entry, invoice, bank connection, accounting report or paid entitlement was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际执行工时登记、开票、银行连接、会计报表或付费权限。
